title: Identify the names of cards that are legal in the 'commander' format, have
question: Identify the names of cards that are legal in the 'commander' format, have no content warning, feature the 'legendary' frame effect, and are exclusively available online. Among these, return only those whose artist has also illustrated at least one card with a ruling issued after January 1, 2020. Order the results alphabetically by card name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_049
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
WHERE l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
  AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
  AND c.XCL_064 IS NULL
  AND c.XCL_018 = 'legendary'
  AND c.XCL_004 = 'mtgo'
  AND c.XCL_002 IN (
      SELECT c2.XCL_002
      FROM cards c2
      JOIN rulings r ON c2.XCL_072 = r.XCL_090
      WHERE r.XCL_088 > '2020-01-01'
  )
ORDER BY c.XCL_049
